why: The admitted library member rows (design/library-rows.md, 2026-10-28 library members). A locale read inside a map, some, filter or reduce callback is one world transition per element in index order, the same on both sides. lowerAll: the candidate reads toLocaleUpperCase: refuted. hasName (some), nestedCount (filter inside map, reduce) and labelsMap (a renamed callback parameter) untouched or renamed: proved. matchAll on a const g pattern that nothing in the file advances (TOKEN, WORD) and on a fresh new RegExp(src, g) is one function of the pattern and the string: tokens and sepCount untouched: proved; wordLetters counts 1 per match where the parent counts its length: refuted. A member read on a type that reaches a module the program cannot resolve (Omit<express Request, user> & {user}) is an accessor of the value, one function the same on both sides: pageOf untouched: proved; providerOf falls back to another default: refuted. The refused forms of the rows have escape fixtures library_locale_callback, library_matchall_named, library_members_matchall_exec and library_members_matchall_exported and library_members_undeclared_member.
